name: Patterns Catalog
description: A read-only reference catalog of engineering patterns, browsable in the console. It covers an SDLC delivery-workflow view and a Mainframe Modernization pattern catalog (COBOL, JCL, DB2, IMS, re-engineering, strangler-fig, microservice extraction, and more). It is off until an operator turns it on: install it, then grant it to a team to make its catalog pages available. It holds no credentials and reaches nothing outside itself — its sidecar only serves the catalog pages, which the console displays inline. Agents can list the available catalogs with the dependency-free `aee-patterns` command-line tool (e.g. `aee-patterns list`).
promptLine: You can browse the read-only Patterns Catalog (SDLC workflow + Mainframe Modernization patterns) — a human reference surfaced in the console. List the available catalogs with `aee-patterns list` (run `aee-patterns --help`).
